method.what_body: TODO_TRANSLATE Reach is a policy design tool that audits which poor households are missed by social protection support in Rwanda. It compares existing targeting with model-ranked and transparent scorecard rules using weighted survey estimates, not household records.
method.data_body: TODO_TRANSLATE {n_households} households in {n_districts} districts, {n_strata} strata and {n_clusters} clusters, from the {survey} survey. Every figure is weighted so it describes Rwanda, not only the sample. Persons: {persons_poor} poor, {persons_extreme_poor} extremely poor.
method.read_title: TODO_TRANSLATE How to read the numbers
method.read_body: TODO_TRANSLATE Every estimate has a 95% interval. If two intervals overlap, the difference is not clear. The small-sample badge means fewer than 30 poor households or fewer than 10 supported households.
method.rule_findings: TODO_TRANSLATE At the programmes’ own coverage ({budget_share}), observed targeting reaches {observed} of poor households. Rule B reaches {b_reached} (gain {b_gain} per 1,000 poor households, 95% interval {b_interval}); the scorecard reaches {c_reached} (gain {c_gain}, 95% interval {c_interval}). Rule B clearly beats observed targeting in {b_districts} of {n_districts} districts and Rule C in {c_districts}.
method.sensitivity_reach: TODO_TRANSLATE Poor households reached at observed coverage
method.sensitivity_3: TODO_TRANSLATE Housing, water, energy and livestock only
method.limit_district: TODO_TRANSLATE Results are available at district level only.
method.limit_programme_counts: TODO_TRANSLATE Programme counts are small, so “any support” is the headline measure.
method.limit_extreme_poverty: TODO_TRANSLATE Extreme poverty estimates are noisy by district.
method.limit_reverse_causality: TODO_TRANSLATE Support can raise consumption, so exclusion can be understated and leakage overstated.
method.limit_survey_label: TODO_TRANSLATE Programmes select households by their own criteria; the rules are judged against the survey’s poverty label.
method.limit_individuals: TODO_TRANSLATE The tool cannot identify real households.
method.limit_financial_inclusion: TODO_TRANSLATE Financial inclusion is measured generously: any household member counts, and mobile money is included.
method.definition_any_support: TODO_TRANSLATE Receipt of direct support, classic public works, expanded public works, or nutrition-sensitive direct support.
method.definition_exclusion_error: TODO_TRANSLATE The share of poor households that receive no support.
method.definition_leakage: TODO_TRANSLATE The share of supported households that are not poor.
method.definition_triple_gap: TODO_TRANSLATE The share of households that are poor, receive no support, and have no access to formal financial services.
method.definition_financially_excluded: TODO_TRANSLATE No household member has a formal financial account or access to a financial service; mobile money is counted as access.

brief.action_targeting: TODO_TRANSLATE Review targeting criteria: exclusion error is clearly above the national benchmark.
brief.action_access: TODO_TRANSLATE Pair support with savings groups or mobile-money access: triple-gap share is clearly above the national benchmark.
brief.action_screening: TODO_TRANSLATE Test scorecard as a screening aid with current criteria: model-ranked or scorecard targeting clearly improves reach at observed coverage.
brief.action_small_cell: TODO_TRANSLATE Collect more data and interpret these figures with care because the sample is small.
brief.action_review: TODO_TRANSLATE Review targeting criteria only where the exclusion error is clearly above the national value.

brief.simulator_note: TODO_TRANSLATE Gain and interval are taken from simulator observed-coverage comparison.
brief.limitations: TODO_TRANSLATE Limitations: district-level survey estimates; small samples; not a list of real households. Receiving support can change a household’s welfare.
brief.action_monitor: TODO_TRANSLATE Monitor coverage as new data arrives.
brief.action_outreach: TODO_TRANSLATE Review local enrolment and service-access barriers with community partners.
brief.action_evaluate: TODO_TRANSLATE Track whether programme reach and household welfare change over time.
